title: GHA: bump some jobs to ubuntu-26.04
body:
In jobs that may benefit from newer tool versions (pyspelling, possibly
CodeQL, CM integration, configure-vs-cmake). Also curl-for-win to match
the curl/curl-for-win repo that also bumped. Bump some Linux jobs to add
variation. Also the rest of `check*` jobs for no particular reason other
than using the latest.

Follow-up to 8f5e4f020e79ec1fd1e8540bdea3c1c20030405b #22097
Follow-up to 139ce4d37cfdc3126179bdb166ec61a095360c62 #22096
Follow-up to e44f1a1446f8e72573e5a1026807e71a0495f88d #22094

---

Before:
https://github.com/curl/curl/actions/runs/28168954397/job/83427930048 cm-integration
https://github.com/curl/curl/actions/runs/28160822614/job/83400580177 pyspelling
https://github.com/curl/curl/actions/runs/28168954389/job/83427930384 complexity

After:
https://github.com/curl/curl/actions/runs/28177031065/job/83456087337 cm-integration
https://github.com/curl/curl/actions/runs/28177030930/job/83456087019 pyspelling
https://github.com/curl/curl/actions/runs/28177031111/job/83456087189 complexity

This PR was initially used to test all jobs with ubuntu-26.04, and fix all issues
found. Then settled on bumping job where it made sense.

- [x] decide which jobs to bump to 26.04?
- [x] merge non-bump changes separately.

Maybe related:
- `test_20_11_crazy_pings` pytest sometimes fails with:
  ```
  assert (8.821442485447847 * 1.1) >= 10.95571808863324
  assert (9.005785951118735 * 1.1) >= 10.99044526740662
  ```
  Ref: https://github.com/curl/curl/actions/runs/27787480749/job/82227836278#step:50:1769
  Ref: https://github.com/curl/curl/actions/runs/27784583373/job/82217840251#step:50:1769
  Ref: 849317ff5c5a5e13f50ec3d001e46ddffa77d8a4 #21911
